entities.summary: Duck TV is a children's television channel which was launched in October 2007 as Bebe TV on UPC and was owned by WICKS Communications, and available in Hungary, Romania, Spain, Slovakia and Czech Republic. Since its launch, the service also airs in Poland, Bulgaria, Serbia, Croatia, Albania, Montenegro, Malta, Cyprus, Lithuania, Belarus, Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany, Slovenia, Portugal, Russia, Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Jordan, Egypt, South Korea, Japan, Sweden, Iceland, Latvia, Estonia, Sri Lanka, United States, Guatemala, Georgia, Turkey, Vietnam, and Canada.
